title: SpatialEdit-16B: Fine-Grained Image Spatial Editing
summary: A multimodal research model designed for precise geometric image manipulations, enabling users to move, rotate, or scale objects and adjust camera viewpoints with high mathematical accuracy. It integrates a Qwen3-VL multimodal encoder with an MM-DiT diffusion decoder for state-of-the-art spatial reasoning.
research_notes: Utilizes the SpatialEdit-500K synthetic dataset for training and introduces SpatialEdit-Bench for measuring geometric fidelity and perceptual plausibility.

evolution.summary: Developed from an earlier 7B LLaVA-based prototype to address spatial failures in models like GPT-4V. It now serves as a foundational baseline for 3D-aware image editing and maintaining consistency in video generation models.
